# Type.TableSchema

```m
Type.TableSchema(tableType as type) as table
```

Returns a table describing the columns of `tableType`.

Refer to the documentation for `Table.Schema` for a description of the resulting table.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Optional |
|---|---|---|
| `tableType` | `type` | no |
